title: Escape on a closed dropdown toggle inside a modal must close the modal
summary: When focus is on a closed dropdown button inside a modal, the dropdown swallows the Escape key, so keyboard users cannot dismiss the modal.
dependencies: vendor/popperjs-core: @popperjs/core 2.9.1 dist/esm from the npm tarball (MIT), mapped with an import map
consumer: Author-written file sharing dialog page around the unchanged upstream source at buggyCommit; an import map adds the .js extensions Bootstrap's extensionless source imports need in a browser.
